note: A documentation site built and deployed on push to the protected main: mkdocs build, then GitHub's own configure, upload and deploy pages actions, with contents: read plus the pages and id-token writes the deploy action needs. Only GitHub-owned actions run, which the shipped configuration trusts, the branch is protected, and nothing else enters the job, so no path is anchored. Had a third-party action built the site, the spec's fact table (id-token: write and the github-pages environment) would price it High or Critical, not Medium (see QUESTIONS row 414).
